title: 📘 Khaos Nexus Guide
description:
Everything you need to understand the community and currently supported systems. Choose a topic below.

If a feature is still being tested, it will not appear here until it is ready for players.

topics.label: Getting Started
topics.summary: The quickest path from joining Khaos Nexus to being ready to play.
details: Read the server rules first, then choose the game and notification roles you want.
Introduce yourself if you would like, then use the game hubs and status panels to find the community features for each supported game.
Use /guide at any time to reopen this guide without finding the original panel.

topics.label: Community & Roles
topics.summary: How self-roles, community roles, and notifications are organized.
details: Self-role menus let you choose relevant games, platforms, notifications, and other community options without waiting for staff.
Community and supporter roles do not grant staff or moderation authority.
Use only the roles that are useful to you so announcements and game pings stay relevant.

topics.label: ARK Cluster
topics.summary: The Khaos Nexus ARK: Survival Ascended cluster and its player-facing tools.
details: The cluster currently includes Genesis 1 and Astraeos, with Sentinel providing shared Discord-side status and management features.
Character and item transfers are governed by the cluster's current transfer settings and server rules.
Use /ark status for health, /ark players for player counts, /ark servers for the server list, /ark mods for active mods, and /ark tame for creature lookup tools.

topics.label: Account Linking
topics.summary: Why linking your Discord account to your ARK EOS identity matters.
details: A linked identity lets Nexus services recognize the same ARK player across cluster maps instead of treating each map as a separate account.
Linking uses your EOS player identity; Sentinel verifies the link before saving it.
Only use the official Sentinel linking flow shown in Discord. Staff should never ask you to post passwords, account tokens, or private credentials.

topics.label: Nexus Points & Shop
topics.summary: The shared ARK economy and how Nexus Points follow your linked player identity.
details: Nexus Points are the cluster's shared shop currency and are associated with your ARK identity rather than a single map.
When ArkShop services are online, supported maps use the shared economy backend so an existing balance can follow the same EOS identity across the cluster.

If the shop is temporarily in maintenance, purchases may be unavailable until the backend and ARK integration are healthy again. Sentinel will not intentionally charge a purchase that cannot enter the supported delivery flow.

topics.label: Spending Nexus Points on ARK
topics.summary: How to spend Points on caches and the starter kit, and where to see your balance.
details: Points live in /points, which is the bank. There is nothing to deposit or withdraw. The shop is not open yet, so nothing can be spent.

Playing earns Points. Shadow Recruit earns 2 Points every 5 minutes, which is 24 an hour, with no offline Points. Cipher Runner, Nexus Raider, Khaos Warden, and Blackout Legend earn 4 every 5 minutes, which is 48 an hour, plus 4, 6, 8, or 10 Points an hour while offline. Origin Founder earns 10 every 5 minutes, which is 120 an hour, plus 4 Points an hour while offline. Offline Points stop after 48 hours.
When the shop opens, the planned prices are Coastal 150, Forest 200, Swamp 200, Mountain 250, Winged 300, Ocean 350, Deep Cave 350, Fantastical 400, Bob's Tall Tales 400, and Apex 550 Points.
The starter kit will be free, once per player. It is delivered on whatever map you are on.
If you are offline, or online on more than one map, the order stays queued. When you are on one map, it delivers there.

If nothing was sent, a failed delivery is refunded right away. An order that is still queued after 14 days is refunded. A delivered order is not refunded. If delivery is unclear, it needs a staff member.

topics.label: Ranks & Supporter Perks
topics.summary: Community progression and supporter benefits without staff authority.
details: Community progression includes Survivor, Veteran, Elite, and Legend tiers where enabled.
Supporter benefits are designed as community perks and incentives rather than moderation power or an automatic competitive advantage.
Staff and moderation permissions are separate from player ranks and supporter status.

topics.label: ARK Crosschat
topics.summary: How ARK chat can be shared between cluster maps and Discord.
details: Crosschat helps players on different ARK maps stay in the same conversation and can mirror supported chat into Discord.
The current ARK crosschat transport uses the AAT ASA mod. AAT is a game mod, not an ArkServerAPI plugin.
Crosschat availability can be affected by an ARK mod update or server maintenance even when the rest of the cluster is online.

topics.label: Game Hubs & Commands
topics.summary: Where to find supported games and the most useful player commands.
details: Game hubs collect status, announcements, LFG, and game-specific tools so you do not need to search the whole Discord.
Useful ARK commands include /ark status, /ark players, /ark servers, /ark mods, and /ark tame.
Use /guide to reopen this guide. Commands that control servers, configuration, moderation, or staff operations are intentionally not part of the public guide.

topics.label: Creators & D&D
topics.summary: Community spaces for creators and tabletop campaigns.
details: The creator program provides dedicated community support for approved creators and live-content activity.
Khaos Nexus also has D&D and campaign spaces with tools designed for campaign organization and play.
Check the relevant hub or application channel for the currently available creator and campaign options.

topics.label: Rules & Help
topics.summary: Where to check current rules, ask for help, and report a problem.
details: The Rules channel is the authority for current community and server rules.
Use the appropriate help, suggestion, or private reporting flow when you need staff assistance rather than posting sensitive information publicly.
If a guide entry and an official staff announcement conflict, follow the newer official announcement and let staff know the guide needs an update.

topics.label: ARN Tokens
topics.summary: A chance at a token when you tame or defeat a shiny on the ARK cluster.
details: Taming a shiny has a 25% chance to earn 1 ARN token. Defeating one has a 10% chance. Your in-game name has to match one linked ARK account exactly.
You can earn up to 3 tokens a day and 10 a week, using Central time. A held account does not earn tokens, and missed chances are not paid later.
Use /arn tokens to see your balance. Redeem in #dino-box-shop. An ARN cache costs 1 token and draws one tame from a list of 8 that changes every Monday at 12:00 AM Central time.
Tokens are not Points, Coins, or the old cache currency. This is not turned on yet, so nothing is paid out and no tame is sent until it is.

topics.label: Birthdays
topics.summary: A private birthday present you open yourself.
details: Use /card birthday set to save a month, day, and timezone. The date stays off your public card.
A Nexus Coins present can be opened once each calendar year with /card birthday gift. It arrives in the morning, in your timezone.
Birthdays stay private unless you allow a celebration. The date, year, and age are never posted.
This is not turned on yet, so no present is sent until it is.

topics.label: Coin shop
topics.summary: Spend Nexus Coins on wallet cosmetics. Coins and Points stay separate.
details: The Coin shop isn't open yet. When it is, open /shop and choose Coin Shop (cosmetics). It shows your Coin balance, the themes, and the titles.
Nebula is 285 Coins. Circuit is 315 Coins. Night Owl is 195 Coins. Each one is cosmetic only and has no gameplay effect.
Only a verified member can buy. A purchase is yours alone, it cannot be gifted, and each item can be owned once.
You can spend up to 1,500 Coins in the shop on one day.
A purchase is not refunded from the shop. A staff member can refund it within 24 hours.
After you buy, the receipt has Equip now, which opens /wallet so you can wear the title or theme.
Coins are not Points. The Coin shop does not spend Points, and the Points shop does not spend Coins.
